units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:4">Bets. IV, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 32a:8">32ᵃ</cite>) <he>אין פּוֹחֲתִין את הנר</he> (Mish. <he>פיתחין</he>, corr. acc.) you must not hollow out a lump of clay to make it a candlestick (on the Holy Day). Ib. 3 <he>פּיֹחֵת לכתחלה</he> he may start to dig out (take out closely packed fruit), v. infra.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 4:5">Mikv. IV, 5</cite> <he>פְּחָתוּהָ</he> they hollowed it out (widened the aperture in the rock through which the water came forth); Y. Yeb. I, end, 3ᵇ (Bab.

<cite ref="Yevamot 15a:17">ib. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>הרחיבוה</he>). Mikv. l. c. <he>עד שיִפְחוֹת רובה</he> (ed. Dehr. a. Mish. ed. <he>עד שיִפְחֲתוּ</he>) until the larger portion of the aperture is chiselled out; Y. Yeb. l. c. <he>שיפחות את רובה</he>; Bab. ib. l. c. <he>שתִּיפָּחֵת ברובה</he>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to diminish, lessen, decrease, opp. הוסיף. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 2 שלא תִפְחוֹת ולא תוסיף from which you must not diminish, and to which you must not add.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 21b:5">Sabb. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>פּוֹחֵת והולך</he> one kindles one light less every night.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:1">Meg. IV, 1</cite>, sq. <he>אין פּוֹחֲתִין וכ׳</he> we call up no less (than the number named) nor more.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:11:5">Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חמרתה</he> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>) <he>פּוֹחֶתֶת אינה פוחתת וכ׳</he> a sheass, if short (whose period of pregnance is the shortest possible) gives birth not earlier than a lunar year from conception, if long, not later than a solar year; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 1:3:8">Y. Nidd. I, 49ᵇ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:1">Pes. X, 1</cite> <he>ולא יִפְחֲתוּ לו מארבע וכ׳</he> and they must give him (the poor man) no less than four cupfuls of wine.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 85b:15">B. Kam. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>שבת הפּוֹחֲתַתּוֹ בדמים</he> (not <he>הפח׳</he>) if the idleness enforced by being wounded has also the effect of lessening his value (if he were to be sold as a slave).

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:4">Shek. V, 4</cite> <he>אם פָּחֲתוּ פחתו לו</he> Y. ed. (differ. in Mishn. ed.) if money is missing, the loss is his. Tanḥ. R’eh 10 <he>פ׳ הוא עשרה ופָחֲתָה היא וכ׳</he> he gave ten measures less as tithe, and it (the field) yielded one hundred less; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 892:1">Yalk. Deut. 892</cite>; a. v. fr.—[Tanḥ. l. c. <he>מי פחת</he>, v. next w.]—V. <cite ref="Q00456"><he>פָּחוּת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 4:4">Ter. IV, 4</cite> <he>פי׳ עשרה וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>פחת</he>) if he set aside as T’rumah ten fractions less (than 1/50, i.e. 1/60), or ten fractions more (i.e. 1/40), Maim.; [R. S. if he reduced the divisor by ten (i.e. set aside 1/40), or increased the divisor by ten (i.e. set aside 1/60); Y. ib. 42ᵈ bot. <he>הפּוֹחֵת אחד מעשרה</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:8">Lev. R. s. 2</cite> <he>כלום פי׳ כבודי וכ׳</he> has my glory or my majesty lost anything &c.?
<cite ref="Chullin 45a:8">Ḥull. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>נִפְחֲתָה כדלת</he> if a piece of the windpipe is broken through in the shape of a door (split on three sides and attached by the fourth side).

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:3">Bets. IV, 3</cite> <he>בית … ונ׳</he> a room which was packed with fruits and closed up (with bricks), and which was burst open (the bricks giving way to the pressure), v. supra.

senses.gloss: to be reduced in size, numbers &c.; to be lowered.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 18a:12">Succ. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>בית שנ׳</he> a building which has been reduced (the walls of which have given way partly).
<cite ref="Sotah 5a">Sot. 5ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כל אדם … לבסוף נ׳</he> every man in whom there is haughtiness, will finally be lowered; a. e.

senses.gloss: to lessen, wear out, damage. Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᵈ top כלי נחשׁת … מפני שמַפְחִיתָן if one found copper vessels (keeping them until the owner be found), he may use them for hot water, but not over fire, because he wears them out; (Bab.
(denom. of פָּחוּת) to become less, be damaged.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 18b:2">Succ. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ דופן אמצעי</he> if the middle wall (of a Succah) became reduced (fell in, v. supra); a. e.
